response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale cloud infrastructure or distributed systems work, with most roles centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies; while they have diverse engineering experience and leadership in open source, their technical background does not align with the core cloud compute platform requirements.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across multiple languages and domains.
Demonstrated leadership through open-source projects, workshops, and mentoring activities.
Proven ability to build and deploy scalable systems using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
concerns: Only minimal C++ exposure (LabWindows/CVI role) — far below the 8-year minimum requirement.
No evidence of cloud compute platform design, distributed systems, or hardware architecture experience.
Lacks documented technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering teams as required.
